overview:
The **Battle of Yavin 4 (Exar Kun)** (3997 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Great Sith War**, fought on or above **Yavin 4**. A decisive engagement of the great sith war.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Great Sith War in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Yavin 4 (Exar Kun) within the broader **Great Sith War** campaign. Front-line reports describe a decisive engagement of the great sith war.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **3997 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Great Sith War.
significance: The Battle of Yavin 4 (Exar Kun) illustrates how the Great Sith War reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
